Windows and macOS system notifications for recent unread Inbox arrivals while Morrow Mail is running, awake and syncing. Enabled by default with sender and content hidden. Settings → Mail & Sync can turn them off or show sender only, or sender, subject and a short preview; previews may appear on the lock screen and in notification history. Initial sync, history downloads, flag changes and old restart mail stay quiet. Fresh server delivery can notify even when the sender's Date is old or missing. Historical provider arrival timestamps stay quiet. Bursts across mailboxes share a notification, always with hidden content. Clicking opens the newest available message in its account using a visible preview or an independent reader in Separate window mode, or Inbox if it has gone; removed accounts are ignored. System permissions and Focus / Do Not Disturb control delivery. Failed or suppressed attempts do not replay. Windows closing the main window quits; macOS hiding it keeps sync running, but Quit stops it. Installed Windows builds need their Start menu shortcut; portable delivery is not guaranteed. Native Windows/macOS delivery remains unverified.
